text.en: Dog owners report that their pets return home cheerful, clean, and relaxed after daycare and overnight boarding on Maple Avenue. Reviewers appreciate that older dogs receive tailored attention and that pets show genuine excitement when arriving at the facility. Several clients emphasise that the staff treat boarding animals with genuine warmth and individual consideration.

Many clients commend individual daycare handlers and kennel attendants for being accommodating, flexible with busy schedules, and genuinely caring towards the dogs. In contrast, multiple visitors highlight negative encounters with front desk staff, reporting instances of discourteous receptionists and sudden early departures during scheduled collection windows.

Several owners value receiving proactive phone check-ins and reassuring progress reports while travelling away from their dogs. However, dissatisfied reviewers note unreturned telephone calls during morning collection hours and a perceived lack of transparency regarding booking policies when issues arose at reception.

q.en: Does Abbie's Dog House accommodate elderly dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the staff successfully accommodated senior dogs on short notice and provided attentive care.

q.en: Are overnight dog boarding stays cage-free?

a.en: The facility offers cage-free daycare and boarding with communal playrooms and overnight rooms with bedding.

q.en: Do pet owners receive progress updates during boarding?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention receiving telephone updates and reassuring reports regarding their dog's wellbeing.

q.en: What are the standard collection hours for pets?

a.en: Collection takes place during posted operating hours, though visitors advise confirming arrangements directly with reception.
